steps.content: As the artificial monstrosity ravages the tower, injuring all in its path, chaos erupts across Fraser City—this time, deep within the Luminaris Society itself.

steps.speaker: A.S. Researcher B
steps.content: What in the world is happening?! Why is something like that buried under our headquarters?! Adelaide never said a word about this.

steps.speaker: A.S. Researcher A
steps.content: It's no good. We can't override the anti-Aurum Secretum device. It's woven with the sorcery of the "Sophos." Someone must be controlling it... Could it be the "Sophos"? But why? Weren't they supposed to be with us?

steps.speaker: A.S. Researcher B
steps.content: Whoever's behind it, we're the ones who'll pay the price! Unauthorized deployment of an artificial weapon, disrupting the Unity Gala, slaughtering the senators... any one of those is enough to finish us!

steps.speaker: A.S. Researcher B
steps.content: We need to find the Director, now! We can't just stand around waiting for this to blow up in our faces.
In the shadows at the lab's depths, a woman in white stands motionless before a containment unit, her gaze fixed on the dark mist swirling inside.
Malevolent energy churns within, where a substance resembling a miniature Black Ring slowly gestates in the gloom.
The communicator in her pocket has been ringing urgently for several minutes. She finally touches the button and answers with unhurried calm.

steps.speaker: Lana Kantarella
steps.content: Compose yourselves. I am fully aware of the situation. Everything is proceeding under the Sophos' guidance.

steps.speaker: Lana Kantarella
steps.content: The Aurum Secretum Warriors positioned throughout the gala have already begun their operation. They will secure us the time and the leverage we need.

steps.speaker: A.S. Researcher B
steps.content: The warriors... might stop that artificial creature, yes... but that won't clear the Luminaris Society's name! We'll be held accountable!

steps.speaker: Lana Kantarella
steps.content: The Luminaris Society... When did it become little more than a toy Adelaide Campbell handed to his sister? An empty title. Nothing more.

steps.speaker: Lana Kantarella
steps.content: But the wisdom we pursue requires no such facade to conceal it.

steps.speaker: A.S. Researcher B
steps.content: Director Kantarella, what... what are you saying?!

steps.speaker: Lana Kantarella
steps.content: ...Do you recall the man I had you hunt down? He was an enemy of the Sophos. A traitor to reason itself.

steps.speaker: Lana Kantarella
steps.content: You eliminated him—truly eliminated him—with your technology and your tactics. Again and again, you cast him back into the oblivion of the Black Ring... Well done. The Sophos have taken note of your service. Now stay where you are and await their arrival.

steps.speaker: Lana Kantarella
steps.content: Do not worry. You have been granted passage on the ark the Sophos have built. When the end comes, you will journey to the sanctuary of pure finality. That... is the true reward for those who follow wisdom.
She keeps her voice melodious until the last lie is told, then casually crushes the communicator and discards it into the nearby brush.
No longer needing to placate the witless masses or guide the perpetually lost, she can finally turn away, back to the quiet she has always craved.

steps.speaker: Lana Kantarella
steps.content: The ark has very few seats. Those worthy of crossing the sea were always meant to be rare. For the ordinary, their greatest happiness is to die clinging to their beliefs, free of doubt and fear.
She lifts her gaze. Ahead, at the end of the hallway, stands the figure she reveres.
At this moment, the light of wisdom illuminates the hall of Luminaris. The Director's heart swells as her most sincere smile spreads, and she quickens her pace.

She had long been enlightened, long understood. In this apocalyptic world, people are sacrificial lambs; fame, power, desire—mere mist. She mocks the masses stumbling in blindness, trapped in a night without dawn. But she knows—
Only truth is eternal. Only clarity is precious. Only the Sophos who have pierced the darkness are worthy of being followed.
Now they have come for her, chosen her as they once chose Adelaide Campbell. The Director's steps quicken, her heart racing with anticipation.
...Until she sees the Sophos, normally so dignified and composed, shudder violently.

steps.speaker: Lana Kantarella
steps.content: What?

The Underground Sophos holds most sacred in her heart tries to speak, but no sound emerges. Suddenly, the figure pitches forward, crumbling into a formless pool of black water that splatters across the floor.
And in that place now stands another figure, one who had suppressed their presence like the dead. He remained so completely undetected that even she failed to sense anything wrong.
No... it was that she had refused to believe they shared the same origin.
The figure shifts, stepping from the shadows. Beneath the bandages, a face emerges, one she utterly despises. The face she never wanted to see.
Good day, Madam Director. I was hoping to borrow a few materials from your Society. Would that be convenient?
Or perhaps you'd prefer... "Underground lapdog"? Does that suit you better?

steps.speaker: Lana Kantarella
steps.content: ...! How can it be YOU?!
